scope_guards: The structured record remains a 0-7,000 net dwelling range and is not collapsed to a single value.
The 5,000-home growth-hub concept is not added to or substituted for the structured range.
The up-to-12,000 transformation-area figure is a broader conditional scope and is not additive.
A13 tunnelling and a new rail station remain explicit dependencies rather than completed infrastructure assumptions.
Current SIL, park, sports, woodland and community uses are context, not residential permission or parcel boundaries.
Mixed ownership is not exact HMLR title or proprietor identity.
A point with blank geometry cannot establish an exact site-to-parcel relation.
